comments.note: phpunit.xml had a redundant 'All' testsuite covering <directory>tests</directory> alongside specific named suites (Actions, Cells, Pagination, Rows, Sorting, Settings, Storage) that each cover a sub-directory. PHPUnit 12 changed behavior: it now emits a warning and exits with code 1 when a file is added to two test suites. The 'All' suite was removed; named suites provide complete, non-overlapping coverage. Every subsequent WP that adds a new test directory should add a corresponding named testsuite rather than relying on a catch-all directory scan.

The webcomics-builder vendor copy of mistralys/application-datagrids is installed from dev-main (a GitHub branch). This means any change to application-datagrids requires a manual 'composer update' in webcomics-builder to pull the latest code. A local path repository entry in webcomics-builder composer.json would allow instant reflection of changes without a network round-trip.

comments.note: Regex inconsistency between DataGrid and JsonFileStorage::validateGridID(). DataGrid enforces strict kebab-case (^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$), while JsonFileStorage uses a more permissive pattern (^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]*$) that allows uppercase and underscores. Both patterns prevent path traversal, but they permit different ID formats when JsonFileStorage is used independently of DataGrid. Both validators should use the same regex to guarantee a consistent contract regardless of call site.

JsonFileStorageTest.php is missing the 'invalid grid ID' test case specified in the plan (Step 9: 'Test grid ID validation (invalid chars)'). There is no assertion that DataGridException is thrown when a grid ID containing illegal characters (e.g. '../escape', 'my grid') is passed to get() or set(). All current tests use only valid IDs.

Manager.php declares 'private static ?JsonFileStorage $gridStorage = null'. The property type should be '?GridStorageInterface' to program to the interface rather than the concrete class. The public getter already returns GridStorageInterface — the property type should match. This is introduced by the WP-007 WebcomicsBuilder integration and makes future storage backend swaps require two changes instead of one.

GridSettings::setItemsPerPage(int $value) has no guard against non-positive values. An items-per-page of 0 or negative is semantically invalid and could produce confusing behaviour downstream (e.g., GridPagination::getTotalPages() calls ceil(total / max(1, ipp)), so 0 is silently treated as 1). A simple 'if ($value < 1) throw DataGridException(...)' would make the contract explicit.
